climate.note: values are suggestions; match existing Soul Bound biome ranges

effects.sandstorm_atmosphere: raise fog density / reduce fog far-plane in biome; purely visual; dev decides mechanics

surface.deep: ancient_desert_sandstone -> cracked_desert_sandstone (30% below y_surface-12) -> host dimension stone
surface.accents: polished_mirage_stone exposed on dune wind-cut faces (3%)

mirage_palm.oasis_ring_density: 6-12 per oasis within 9 blocks of water

vegetation_per_chunk_attempts.mirage_lotus: oasis shore + water-adjacent only (4-10 per oasis)

giant_amber_crystals.shape: leaning hexagonal prisms, 3-7 shards; amber glass + singing_crystal_block core

giant_arches.note: ground-anchored both ends on stable dune/sandstone

instrument_crystals.description: harp/organ-pipe arrays; same placement rules as spires

ruins_and_buried_remnants.frequency: 1 per 2 chunks small ruins (sandstone walls/columns, partly buried)

dunes.terrain_shaping: large-scale ridged noise: wavelength 48-96 blocks, amplitude 6-14; secondary ripple 8-16 blocks / amplitude 1-2

oases.radius: 5-9 water pond (depth 2-3), 3-block sandstone/grass rim, palms + lotus + ferns
oases.rule: place in dune troughs, never on slopes >20 deg

Lost_Caravanserai.footprint_check: near oasis or flat dune basin; slope <=2 over 43x43

prism_jerboa.avoid: within 6 blocks of lava/fluids except oasis shore, inside structure interiors except marked encounter areas

creature_spawns.structure_spawns: Caravanserai rest area (guaranteed 1-2), Labyrinth sanctuary, Observatory hall, Cathedral hall (see structure notes)

clearance.trees: trunk base needs 3x3 clear + sky access
clearance.structures: no overlap with oasis water; keep 8 blocks from giant crystals
clearance.formations: anchor on solid ground, min 6 spacing

performance: Cap crystal formations to <= 3 per chunk and avoid generating across >2 chunk borders.
Use feature placement noise (single sample per chunk) rather than per-block rejection loops.
Leaves/lights: glow sources (crystals, lotus, mushrooms) are numerous - cap light-emitting decoration at ~40 per chunk.
Labyrinth/Cathedral NBTs are 33-36k blocks; use rare spacing and place only at structure-start stage.
Glass blocks cause client overdraw: avoid stacking > 6 glass layers in giant formations.
disclaimer: Specification only. No world generation is implemented in this pack.
